'''Jimmy''' (Japanese: '''ジミー''' ''Jimmy'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[AG092|Judgment Day!]]''.

==History==
===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''===
Jimmy considers himself a poor Trainer, having not won a single battle. He often felt he had bad luck, even though he actually had the opposite. Starting out with a {{p|Squirtle}}, he set out on a {{pkmn|journey}} of his own. He soon added an {{p|Ivysaur}} to his [[Party|team]] after he accidentally dropped a sandwich. They then encountered a {{Shiny}} {{p|Magikarp}} that fell out of Jimmy's shirt. Jimmy [[trade]]d the Magikarp to a passerby without realizing its rarity and obtained a {{p|Charmeleon}} in return.

Afterwards, Jimmy went to [[Cerulean City]] and helped {{an|Daisy}} clean the [[Cerulean Gym]], a task that earned him a {{Badge|Cascade}} without having to battle for it. Sometime later, while Jimmy and his Pokémon were sleeping in a small fishing boat, the rope that was tying the boat to the [[Lilycove City]] dock became undone, and the boat floated away into the ocean. By accident, they found themselves on [[Bomba Island]], and he decided to enroll in the island's Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute.

Despite his efforts, Jimmy struggled to become a [[Battle judge|referee]] under Professor {{OBP|Serena|AG092}}. During a mock battle between {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}}, Jimmy acted as the referee, though he proved to be particularly indecisive when it came to making rulings.

While mulling over Serena's advice that night, {{TRT}} arrived with their mecha and stole Jimmy's Pokémon. He chased them and grabbed onto the mecha, though the trio continued to swat him away. Suddenly, his Wartortle evolved into {{p|Blastoise}}, breaking itself free of its containment capsule in the process before blasting Team Rocket off. He then decided to continue his original goal of becoming a Trainer and to return to Lilycove City. The next day, he waved farewell to Ash and his friends when they left the island.

===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''===
Jimmy appeared again in ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}} and Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] battle on [[television]].
